commands.command: for i in $(seq 15); do docker ps -q --filter health=starting | grep -q . || break; sleep 1; done 2>/dev/null; echo '=== containers'; docker ps -aq --no-trunc | xargs -r docker inspect | jq -c '.[] | {Id: .Id, Name: (.Name | ltrimstr("/")), Image: .Image, Created: .Created, Path: .Path, Args: .Args, Pid: .State.Pid, Status: .State.Status, Running: .State.Running, Health: (if .State.Health then .State.Health.Status else "" end), Config: (.Config | {Hostname, Image, User, Env, Cmd, Entrypoint, Labels, ExposedPorts, Healthcheck, WorkingDir}), HostConfig: (.HostConfig | {PortBindings, RestartPolicy, Memory, NanoCpus, CpuQuota, CpuPeriod, PidsLimit, ReadonlyRootfs, CapDrop, CapAdd, SecurityOpt, Privileged, NetworkMode, Tmpfs}), Mounts: [.Mounts[]? | {Type, Name, Source, Destination, RW}], Networks: (.NetworkSettings.Networks // {} | map_values({IPAddress, MacAddress, Aliases, IPAMConfig, NetworkID})), Ports: (.NetworkSettings.Ports // {})}'; echo '=== networks'; docker network ls -q | xargs -r docker network inspect | jq -c '.[] | {Name, Id, Driver, Internal, Options, Labels, IPAM: (.IPAM.Config // []), Containers: (.Containers // {} | map_values({Name, IPv4Address, MacAddress}))}'; echo '=== volumes'; docker volume ls -q | xargs -r docker volume inspect | jq -c '.[] | {Name, Mountpoint, Labels, CreatedAt}'; echo '=== images'; docker image ls -q --no-trunc | sort -u | xargs -r docker image inspect | jq -c '.[] | {Id, RepoTags, RepoDigests, Created, Config: (.Config | {User, Env, Cmd, Entrypoint, ExposedPorts, Healthcheck, Labels, WorkingDir})}'; echo '=== info'; docker info --format '{{json .RegistryConfig}}'; echo '=== compose'; docker compose ls -a --format json; echo '=== end'; true

echo '=== probe counter_redis'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=counter --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=redis | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n timeout 5 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/6379 || exit 1; printf '"'"'CONFIG GET appendonly
'"'"' >&3; timeout 1 cat <&3; true' 2>/dev/null || echo TCP_FAIL; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe counter_volume'; { d=$(docker volume inspect -f '{{.Mountpoint}}' counter_redis-data 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$d" ]; then echo NO_VOLUME; elif grep -rqF -- visits "$d" 2>/dev/null; then echo FOUND; else echo MISSING; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe shop_app_db'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shop --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=app | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n timeout 5 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/10.172.222.100/6379 || exit 1; printf '"'"'PING
'"'"' >&3; timeout 1 cat <&3; true' 2>/dev/null || echo TCP_FAIL; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe shop_proxy_app'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shop --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=proxy | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n dig +short +time=1 +tries=1 @127.0.0.11 app A 2>/dev/null; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe shop_proxy_db'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shop --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=proxy | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n ping -n -c 1 -W 1 10.172.222.100 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PING_OK || echo PING_FAIL; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe shop_proxy_db_dns'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shop --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=proxy | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n dig +short +time=1 +tries=1 @127.0.0.11 db A 2>/dev/null; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe config_secret_app'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=config --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=app | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else head -c 4096 /proc/$P/root/run/secrets/redis_password 2>/dev/null; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe config_secret_redis'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=config --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=redis | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else head -c 4096 /proc/$P/root/run/secrets/redis_password 2>/dev/null; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe config_noauth'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=config --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=redis | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n timeout 5 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/6379 || exit 1; printf '"'"'PING
'"'"' >&3; timeout 1 cat <&3; true' 2>/dev/null || echo TCP_FAIL; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe config_auth'; { P=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=config --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=redis | head -1) 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$P" ] || [ "$P" = 0 ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; else nsenter -t $P -n timeout 5 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/6379 || exit 1; printf '"'"'AUTH 3B7UzpXR5fAEg42C
PING
'"'"' >&3; timeout 1 cat <&3; true' 2>/dev/null || echo TCP_FAIL; fi; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe config_env'; { cat /root/compose/config/.env; } 2>&1; echo '=== probe context'; { docker context inspect prod --format '{{json .Endpoints.docker}}'; } 2>&1; true
